name: Bible
overview: The Bible is presented as the perfect and sure word of God, capable of converting the soul and providing wisdom to the simple, as seen in Psalms 19:7. It is a vital guide for life, described metaphorically as a lamp to our feet and a light to our path (Psalms 119:105), and a source of spiritual nourishment beyond physical sustenance (Matthew 4:4). Scripture is also foundational for faith, which comes through hearing the word of God (Romans 10:17), and it serves as a source of learning, patience, and hope for believers (Romans 15:4). The practice of hiding God's word in the heart (Psalms 119:11) underscores the importance of internalizing Scripture for righteous living.
